name: ImageCompare
description: Two images shown large for comparison: side by side (a build beside its target), or, with mode="slider", laid over each other in one frame with a handle the user drags to reveal before on one side and after on the other.
usage: `images` is a list of `{ label, src, href? }`; each label is the image's alt text and its caption (side by side) or corner label (slider)
Side by side (default): equal width from md up, stacked below md; one image alone takes the full width. Each image is a link opening the full image in a new tab (`href`, default `src`)
`mode="slider"`: the first image is before (left of the handle), the second after (right). Use it for two screenshots of the same screen, such as a change's before and after
In slider mode the images are not links (a drag would follow them) and `href` is ignored; fewer than two images, or one that can't load, falls back to side by side
A broken image falls back to its label and path as text
examples:
import { ImageCompare } from '@levain/ui-react';

<ImageCompare images={[{ label: 'This build', src: '/captures/build.png' }, { label: 'Target', src: '/captures/target.png' }]} />
design: Images sit on --color-surface-section with the subtle border (--color-border-subtle) and --radius-md; each keeps its own aspect ratio, top-aligned, never cropped
Slider: the frame takes the before image's aspect ratio; the after image lies over it, fitted with object-fit contain and top-aligned, clipped at the handle (clip-path inset from the left)

Slider handle: a 2px line in --color-text-default (dark on light, light on dark, so it reads over the screenshot) with elevation-1, and a 32px round grip (GripVertical) on --color-surface-elevated with --color-border-emphasis and elevation-2; it starts at 50%

Slider labels: chips in the top corners (before left, after right), type-caption in --color-text-inverted on --color-surface-inverted (dark on a light theme, light on a dark one, so they read on any screenshot), each fading out (150ms, none under Reduce Motion) while the handle is over it

Slider drag: anywhere on the frame. A mouse or pen press jumps the handle to the point; a touch takes the handle only once it has moved more than 6 px sideways, and more sideways than down, then the handle follows the finger; a touch that moves down first is left to the page. touch-action pan-y: a sideways swipe moves the handle and never scrolls the page sideways, a vertical swipe still scrolls the page
accessibility: Side by side: each image's label is its alt text and caption; each link has a title saying it opens in a new tab
Slider: the handle is role="slider", focusable, named "<before label> and <after label>", aria-valuenow 0-100 and aria-valuetext "Before 50%, After 50%"
Slider keys: Left/Down and Right/Up move the handle 5%, Home and End to the ends
Slider corner labels are aria-hidden (the images' alt text and the handle's name carry them)

props.name: images
props.description: The images, each `{ label: string; src: string; href?: string }`. In slider mode the first is before, the second after

props.name: mode
props.description: Side by side, or the first two in one frame with a drag handle

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer element (the grid, or the slider's frame)
